headline: US Consumer Demand for Beef Remains Resilient Despite High Prices
summary: American consumers continue to buy more beef, second only to chicken, while demand for pork, turkey, and soy products remains flat despite elevated beef prices.
why: Consumer protein preferences and price elasticity directly influence livestock markets, meatpackers, and grocery retail margins.

impacts.name: Live Cattle Futures
impacts.why: Persistent consumer demand despite elevated retail prices supports wholesale beef and live cattle valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
